lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: Once upon a time, at the edge of a wide and peaceful forest, there lived a little mouse who loved exploring.
lines.metadata_style: warm, inviting, gentle sense of wonder

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: The mouse knew every berry bush, every hollow log, and nearly every winding path beneath the trees.
lines.metadata_style: warm, inviting, gentle sense of wonder

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: One afternoon, the mouse wandered farther from home than usual.
lines.metadata_style: warm, inviting, gentle sense of wonder

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: There had been so many wonderful things to eat — tiny seeds beneath the tall grass, sweet berries beside the stream, and one particularly delicious acorn that took much longer to enjoy than expected.
lines.metadata_style: warm, inviting, gentle sense of wonder

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: By the time the mouse finally looked up, the golden afternoon light had begun to fade.
lines.metadata_style: warm, inviting, gentle sense of wonder

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: The shadows beneath the trees were growing longer.
lines.metadata_style: warm, inviting, gentle sense of wonder

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.metadata_text: Oh! It's getting late!
lines.metadata_style: startled realization, then hurried but playful

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: Still holding the acorn, the mouse stood up. Then the little traveler set it carefully beside a stone at the stream.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: Home was still quite a distance away.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: There were two ways to get there.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: One was the familiar path that curved safely around a sunny meadow.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: The other was much shorter.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: It cut straight through a quiet part of the forest that the mouse rarely visited.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: The mouse looked at the darkening sky.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: Then at the long path.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: Then at the shortcut.

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.metadata_text: The shortcut. Definitely the shortcut.

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.metadata_text: I'll be home before the stars come out!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: And off the mouse hurried.
lines.metadata_style: increasingly lively, building toward the accident

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: Past a mossy stone.
lines.metadata_style: increasingly lively, building toward the accident

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: Under a fallen branch.
lines.metadata_style: increasingly lively, building toward the accident

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: Around an old tree stump.
lines.metadata_style: increasingly lively, building toward the accident

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: The mouse ran faster and faster, thinking only of getting home.
lines.metadata_style: increasingly lively, building toward the accident

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: What the mouse did not notice was the enormous lion sleeping beneath a great old tree.
lines.metadata_style: increasingly lively, building toward the accident

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: His mane rested against the grass.
lines.metadata_style: increasingly lively, building toward the accident

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: His eyes were closed.
lines.metadata_style: increasingly lively, building toward the accident

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: And one enormous paw stretched directly across the path.
lines.metadata_style: increasingly lively, building toward the accident

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: The mouse rounded a root—
lines.metadata_style: increasingly lively, building toward the accident

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: and—
lines.metadata_style: increasingly lively, building toward the accident

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.metadata_text: Whoa!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: The mouse tripped over the lion's paw.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: There was a tumble, a roll, and a very surprised little mouse landed right against the lion's enormous nose.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: The lion's eyes opened.

lines.speaker: LION
lines.metadata_text: What in the forest was THAT?
lines.metadata_style: startled, deep and imposing but not frightening

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: The lion lifted his head in surprise. The mouse scrambled down onto the path.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: Before the mouse could scramble away, one enormous paw came down beside the tiny traveler, blocking the path.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: The mouse froze.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: Only moments earlier, getting home before dark had seemed like the biggest problem in the world.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: Suddenly, it did not seem very important at all.

lines.speaker: LION
lines.metadata_text: You woke me from the finest nap I've had all week.

lines.speaker: LION
lines.metadata_text: Why were you racing through here without watching where you were going?

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.metadata_text: I'm sorry! I was eating by the stream, and I didn't notice how late it had become.

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.metadata_text: I took a shortcut because I wanted to get home before dark.

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.metadata_text: I wasn't trying to disturb you. I promise.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: The lion looked down.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: The mouse was trembling.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: He could easily have frightened the little creature even more.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: He could have become angry.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: After all, he was the strongest animal for miles around.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: But being able to frighten someone did not mean that he had to.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: The lion's expression softened.

lines.speaker: LION
lines.metadata_text: Well...

lines.speaker: LION
lines.metadata_text: you certainly chose an exciting shortcut.

lines.speaker: LION
lines.metadata_text: Go home, little one.

lines.speaker: LION
lines.metadata_text: And next time, look where you're running.

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.metadata_text: You're... letting me go?

lines.speaker: LION
lines.metadata_text: You made a mistake.

lines.speaker: LION
lines.metadata_text: You meant no harm.

lines.speaker: LION
lines.metadata_text: I see no reason to hurt you for that.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: The mouse stared up at the lion.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: Anger was what had been expected.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: Instead, the lion had chosen kindness.

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.metadata_text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.metadata_text: I won't forget this.

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.metadata_text: I hope someday I can show someone the same kindness.

lines.speaker: LION
lines.metadata_text: Perhaps you will.

lines.speaker: LION
lines.metadata_text: Now hurry.

lines.speaker: LION
lines.metadata_text: Those stars you were worried about are almost here.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: The mouse smiled and hurried home.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: But this time...

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: a little more carefully.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: Days passed.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: The mouse returned to the usual routines of the forest.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: And the lion returned to his favorite shady tree.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: Neither of them expected that their paths would cross again so soon.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: Then, one morning, something small beneath the leaves caught the lion's eye as he walked through a distant part of the forest.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: He stepped closer.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: His paw pressed a hidden trigger, and a soft rope net dropped from the branches above.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: The net settled over him, leaving his paws safely on the ground.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: He tried one careful tug.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: But the knotted ropes held firm.

lines.speaker: LION
lines.metadata_text: No...

lines.speaker: LION
lines.metadata_text: Come on!

lines.speaker: LION
lines.metadata_text: Why won't this break?

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: The lion was powerful.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: But strength alone could not free him.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: At last, he let out a deep call for help.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: It echoed through the forest.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: And far away, two little ears lifted.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: The mouse knew that voice.

lines.speaker: MOUSE
lines.metadata_text: The lion!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: The mouse ran toward the sound.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: Over roots.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: Between bushes.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: Under branches.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: This time there was no shortcut and no thought of getting home.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: Someone was in trouble.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.metadata_text: That was reason enough to run.
